query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sessionId) FROM funnel_events WHERE eventType = 'quiz_start') as total_quiz_start_sessions,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sessionId) FROM funnel_events WHERE eventType = 'quiz_start' AND lastQuestionReached IS NOT NULL) as sessions_with_question_tracked,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sessionId) FROM funnel_events WHERE eventType = 'quiz_complete') as completions,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_submissions) as total_submissions;
